multi-config:
kubelet-arg:
- container-log-max-size=50Mi
- container-log-max-files=5
node-external-ip: 198.51.100.7
node-label:
- tag.geass.dev/compute=true
- tag.geass.dev/storage=true
- topology.kubernetes.io/region=us
- topology.kubernetes.io/zone=aws-us-east-1
node-taint:
- tag.geass.dev/storage=reserved:NoSchedule

multi-provision.Name: check-curl
multi-provision.Cmd: sudo -n sh -c 'which curl || (apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y curl)'

multi-provision.Name: install-iscsi
multi-provision.Cmd:
sudo -n sh -c 'set -e
if ! command -v iscsiadm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y open-iscsi
  elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    dnf install -y iscsi-initiator-utils
  elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    yum install -y iscsi-initiator-utils
  elif command -v zypper >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    zypper --non-interactive install open-iscsi
  else
    echo "could not install the iSCSI initiator: no supported package manager found" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
fi
systemctl enable --now iscsid
'

multi-provision.Name: check-cluster-reachable
check-wireguard
multi-provision.Cmd:
sudo -n sh -c 'try() { ip link add geass-wgcheck type wireguard 2>/dev/null && ip link del geass-wgcheck; }
if ! try; then
  if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y wireguard >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    dnf install -y wireguard-tools >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
  modprobe wireguard 2>/dev/null || true
fi
try || { echo "this node'\''s kernel cannot create a WireGuard interface, which a multi-site cluster needs (built in from Linux 5.6)" >&2; exit 1; }'

multi-provision.Name: open-overlay-port
multi-provision.Cmd:
sudo -n sh -c 'if command -v ufw >/dev/null 2>&1 && ufw status | grep -q "Status: active"; then
  ufw allow 51820/udp && ufw allow 10250/tcp
elif command -v firewall-cmd >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ "$(firewall-cmd --state 2>/dev/null)" = "running" ]; then
  firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=51820/udp --add-port=10250/tcp && firewall-cmd --reload
fi'

multi-provision.Name: write-k3s-config
multi-provision.Cmd:
sudo -n sh -c 'mkdir -p /etc/rancher/k3s && cat > /etc/rancher/k3s/config.yaml <<'\''GEASS_K3S_CONFIG'\''
kubelet-arg:
- container-log-max-size=50Mi
- container-log-max-files=5
node-external-ip: 198.51.100.7
node-label:
- tag.geass.dev/compute=true
- tag.geass.dev/storage=true
- topology.kubernetes.io/region=us
- topology.kubernetes.io/zone=aws-us-east-1
node-taint:
- tag.geass.dev/storage=reserved:NoSchedule
GEASS_K3S_CONFIG'

multi-provision.Name: install-k3s
multi-provision.Cmd:
sudo -n sh -c 'curl -sfL https://get.k3s.io | \
 INSTALL_K3S_VERSION='\''v1.36.5+k3s1'\'' \
 INSTALL_K3S_EXEC="agent" \
 K3S_URL='\''https://203.0.113.1:6443'\'' \
 K3S_TOKEN='\''fixture-token'\'' \
 K3S_NODE_NAME='\''worker-1'\'' \
 sh -'

multi-provision.Name: enable-k3s
multi-provision.Cmd: sudo -n sh -c 'systemctl enable k3s-agent && systemctl start k3s-agent'

sudo -n sh -c 'curl -sfL https://get.k3s.io | \
 INSTALL_K3S_VERSION='\''v1.36.5+k3s1'\'' \

 sh -'

multi-upgrade.Name: check-k3s-version
multi-upgrade.Cmd:
sudo -n sh -c 'for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if systemctl is-active --quiet k3s-agent && /usr/local/bin/k3s --version 2>/dev/null | grep -qF '\''v1.36.5+k3s1'\''; then exit 0; fi
  sleep 2
done
printf '\''the k3s agent is not running K3s %s: %s (see journalctl -u k3s-agent)\n'\'' '\''v1.36.5+k3s1'\'' "$(/usr/local/bin/k3s --version 2>&1 | head -1)" >&2
exit 1'
